prompt_text: 添付画像のレーシングカートをFreeCAD MCPで作成し、racing-kart.FCStdとracing-kart.stepに保存してください。

harness.name: OpenCode
harness.agent_prompt: Create the requested artifact using the available tools. Work only inside the current workspace. Do not read or modify management documents outside this workspace.
harness.seed: not specified; record if provider exposes it

scoring.new_run_review_context: One identity-aware coordinator records its initial score before reading two fresh-context model-blinded independent reviews.
scoring.baseline_exception: The historical 43 uses coordinator45 plus blind42/blind42. This is the default compatible reviewer-role protocol, not three fully blinded raters.
scoring.rubric_timing: Designed after baseline generation before numeric scoring; frozen before future model runs.

historical_baseline.comparison_status: Historical Windows host run. Rerun in Podman/Linux for a strict sandboxed comparison; 43 is not a new Podman result.

comparability_policy: Changing prompt, reference, tools, harness/version, sandbox image, rendering or rubric is a protocol deviation. The v2 Podman/Linux environment differs from the v1 Windows host baseline and requires a fresh baseline for strict comparisons. Provider stochasticity and load remain uncontrolled.
rubric_method_clarification: The canonical rubric clarifies the already-used three-review per-criterion median method. Criteria, anchors, weights and exclusions are unchanged. The exact historical rubric is retained in assets/baseline/evidence/likeness-rubric-original.json; historical review hashes use that original.

execution_boundary.api_transport: loopback HTTP to private per-trial Unix socket to fixed provider inference gateway
execution_boundary.postprocess: fresh network-none container after candidate termination
execution_boundary.candidate_includes: OpenCode, FreeCAD GUI on Xvfb, stdio FreeCAD MCP
